quote: Unless otherwise provided by ordinance of the local authority having jurisdiction, a person shall not: Stop, stand or park a vehicle within an alley in a business district except for the expeditious loading or unloading of goods.

activation.condition: A responsible person stops, stands or parks a motor vehicle within a source-qualified business-district alley.

exceptions.description: Source-proven actual expeditious goods loading or unloading.
exceptions.source_clause: except for the expeditious loading or unloading of goods

exceptions.description: Source-reviewed effective and applicable local ordinance otherwise provides.
exceptions.source_clause: Unless otherwise provided by ordinance of the local authority having jurisdiction

judgment_calls_needed.note: Source-reviewed alley, public use, frontage, business uses and local jurisdiction are required.
judgment_calls_needed.phrase: within an alley in a business district

judgment_calls_needed.note: Original vehicle, driver and traffic histories distinguish the alternatives; no duration surrogate is asserted.
Actual goods contact and idle intervals are measured; expeditiousness remains a legal judgment.
judgment_calls_needed.phrase: expeditious loading or unloading of goods

judgment_calls_needed.note: Effective text, issuing authority, jurisdiction and applicability require independent review.

obligation.description: Do not stop, stand or park in the covered alley unless an exception or applicable local ordinance provides otherwise.

timing.description: Measure original actor contact, driver presence, halt and idle intervals across the 45-second capture.
